items.summary: Update WASM TTS Engine to 20260820.1, rewrite Ukrainian docs, and sync translations
items.fullMessage:
Update WASM TTS Engine to 20260820.1, rewrite Ukrainian docs, and sync translations

- Update bundled Google WASM TTS engine from 20260806.1 to 20260820.1:
  * Added C++ core enhancements for phrase pronunciation (WordwisePhrasePronounce) and regex text normalization (RegexpRewriteRuleGroup).
  * Refined OpenFST finite-state memory allocation for cleaner heap usage.
  * Updated browser harness to dynamically detect the AudioContext instance instead of relying on minified property names.
- Rewrite and standardize Ukrainian documentation (doc/uk/readme.html):
  * Generated with AI assistance to strictly adhere to official NVDA Ukrainian UI translations and documentation, as well as the add-on translation by @George-br.
  * Replaced the previous Ukrainian doc, which appeared to be an outdated copy of the legacy repository readme.md that was inconsistent with the layout and structure of readme.html.
- Synchronize all translations and documentation:
  * Automatically bumped the version 1.0 release date and last modified date to August 29, 2026 across all documentation and manifest files.
  * Automatically updated the WASM TTS engine version string across all 6 localization catalogs (es, ru, uk, vi, zh_CN, zh_TW) and recompiled binary .mo catalogs with zero missing or obsolete strings, requiring no manual actions from translation contributors.
